text.tspan: In the text-visual setup, the model receives
an input image along with a descriptive text prompt.
The image-text fusion module combines these visual
and textual cues into prompt embeddings.
SAM consumes the image and prompt embeddings
to segment the referred object.
However, this dual-modality approach struggles to
distinguish sounding objects in ambiguous scenes.
In the audio-visual setup, the image is paired
directly with an audio waveform.
An image-audio fusion block integrates acoustic signals
to generate audio-guided embeddings.
SAM uses these embeddings to locate the
sounding source in the image.
Without textual context, it fails to
interpret dynamic referring expressions.
The proposed architecture instead jointly ingests
video frames, textual expressions, and audio waveforms.
A unified fusion module compresses all three modalities
into a single segmentation prompt embedding.
This fused prompt guides SAM2 to track and
segment the target across the entire sequence.
Consequently, accurate spatio-temporal segmentation
masks are generated across all video frames.
